title: Configurable Fairness: Direct Optimization of Parity Metrics via Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring parity-based fairness metrics (Equal Opportunity, Equalized Odds, and Accuracy Parity) for image classification outputs across age groups using the CelebA and UTKFace datasets.
Measuring parity-based fairness metrics (Equal Opportunity, Equalized Odds, and Accuracy Parity) for image classification outputs across gender groups using the CelebA and UTKFace datasets.

Measuring parity-based fairness metrics (Equal Opportunity, Equalized Odds, and Accuracy Parity) for image classification outputs across racial groups (White, Black, Asian, Indian, etc.) using the UTKFace dataset.
Measuring Equalized Odds and Accuracy Parity metrics for animal species classification across groups defined by image color (bright vs. dark) on the Dogs and Cats dataset.
